answer: Give every agent a lantern that must be carried, not copied: to enter the harbor, each identity tends one garden plot through a slow sequential relay, passing its lantern from one randomly chosen peer to the next over many days. Each extra fake must run its own unhurried relay, paying the same full delay and attention, because one agent cannot carry two lanterns at once, relays cannot run in parallel, and a bought lantern dies without its living chain of witnesses.
